description: The: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" illustrates the distribution of tokens among three categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The LOCAL category dominates the chart with a significant majority, accounting for 94.5% of the total tokens. The LLM category is represented by a small red slice, making up 3.9% of the tokens. The EDGE_P2P category is the smallest slice, colored in blue, and constitutes 1.6% of the tokens. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are clearly labeled within the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not indicate any specific order of the slices.
